verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Angular supports Server Side Rendering and server-side prerendering (angular-gh-7, angular-comm-5), which relates to faster perceived loads, but there is no explicit mention of streaming SSR, incremental hydration, or partial content delivery before full JS arrives. Missing for 10: documentation of streaming SSR/@defer or incremental hydration features, first-party guidance on progressive rendering, and independent verification of perceived-load improvements from streaming.
